extracted.name: Raisin Bread French Toast Casserole
extracted.description: This delightful raisin bread French toast casserole features cubes of cinnamon raisin bread baked in a buttery egg mixture. Serve warm with maple syrup.
ingredient_lines: 3 tablespoons softened butter, cut into chunks
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Lightly butter an 8x8-inch baking dish.
Pour bread cubes into the prepared dish.

Beat milk, eggs, sugar, and vanilla together in a large bowl until evenly mixed; pour mixture over bread cubes. Arrange butter chunks atop bread mixture. Set aside for bread to absorb liquid, about 10 minutes. Sprinkle the top with cinnamon.
Bake in the preheated oven until top is golden, 45 to 50 minutes.
